'''Tellus T'arch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who served under the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. She was present in the [[Strike Base XR-484|Imperial Command Center]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the Empire's [[Invasion of Ossus|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. She wore black [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian tracker armor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Tellus T'arch serves as a skill trainer for the Bounty Hunter class on the Imperial Side at [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] within the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
